opening.argument: The material presents an instructional walkthrough for configuring an advertising campaign intended to generate tech-support calls. Its subject is identified as “How to Generate Inbound Calls for Tech Support,” and the displayed workflow shows campaign fields for an advertising URL, bid limits, a daily limit, traffic network, and submission. Instructional notes also accompany scheduling and channel selections. The payment requirement and statements about campaign approval and call volume are presented as terms of that advertising service. Nothing available establishes deception, false claims, completed payment, delivered results, or victim loss, so the material supports an educational and operational demonstration rather than a finding of wrongdoing.

citations.quote: How to Generate Inbound Calls for Tech Support
